description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing courses in a learning management system. It provides endpoints to retrieve the authenticated user's courses, create a new course, and fetch details of a specific course by ID.

classes.name: CourseController
classes.description: REST controller handling course-related endpoints, secured and documented with Swagger annotations.

methods.name: myCourses
methods.description: Retrieves courses that the currently authenticated user is enrolled in.

methods.name: createCourse
methods.description: Allows authorized users to create a new course, setting themselves as the owner.

methods.name: getCourse
methods.description: Fetches a course by its ID.
